posts.name: Matchstickman
posts.cooked:
Another week and another report for my adoring fans. I know you are here for my numbers and not Silverleaf's hat.

Had a pretty terrible week so far as my time was concerned, I lost 5 days! I realised there was an error in my formula, I was counting from the day I bought the game, not the start of the year. It changed the hours needed each day from 2.6 to 3.01, so still just within the 3 hours per day I previously had but now I can't skip a day if things come up. The sacrifices I must make to reach my goal are as horrible as they are numerous.

I've currently got 271 hours under my belt, so I've passed the 100 hour point now, everything should be downhill from now on. Here's hoping Handelabra don't release Kismet or Setback to jinx me now!

posts.name: Sonvar
posts.cooked: If you fall behind you should ask them to send Omnitron-X or Chrono Ranger.

posts.name: Matchstickman
posts.cooked:
What do marathon runners and I have in common?

Apart from amazing physical fitness, we both know the dread of "the wall". This week I have been feeling the fatigue set in from having to play so much Sentinels every day, it's really such a chore you know.

I thought about admitting defeat and just stopping so I didn't come to resent playing, but instead I pulled back and played less hours this week. I still have a buffer from overplaying earlier so it isn't like I'm behind yet, but I can see the spectre of defeat getting ever closer now.

I think I will be counting down rather than up from here on out, it makes the totals involved look more manageable.

79 hours to go!

posts.name: Matchstickman
posts.cooked:
I have no idea how many hours I have played this week. I can tell you how many Steam says I played but that is not the same thing.
On 3 seperate occassions I looked at the time and had 313 hours or more and when I started steam again it had dropped the time to below 313.
I finally broke that stupid barrier very late Friday night, putting me at "only" 15 hours away from getting back to my goal of 3 hours a day with just Saturday & Sunday to play that staggering amount of time to put me back on schedule before I post this (I write as I go). I sure as hell better feel some sort of sense of accomplishment if I make this stupid 365 hours arbitrary goal I set myself!
...
Nope, I only got in 11 of the 15 hours, but I am at 37 hours to go so it's not a terrible showing this week.
